correlationId.description: Client-generated UUID v4 used to correlate each request/response pair.

positionKm.description: Cartesian query point in km in the selected system's spatial coordinates. The server compares it directly with stored spatial.positionKm; it does not apply a display transform. Required only for radius queries. Omit together with distanceKm for whole-system listing mode.

distanceKm.description: Required only for radius queries. Omit together with positionKm for whole-system listing mode.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item to return after filtering and sorting. An offset at or past total returns an empty page with success true.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 100; values above 500 are clamped to 500. Non-integers and values below 1 fail. Whole-system listings are ordered by id; radius queries by distanceKm, then id. Callers that need every match must keep requesting pages until hasMore is false.
